title: States of matter
subtitle: I can describe solids, liquids and gases using the particle model
criteria: Describe the particles in each state
Name the four changes of state
Predict the effect of heating or cooling

blocks.text: Answer every question in full sentences. Use the word bank to help you.
Describe how the particles are arranged in a solid.
blocks.answer: They are packed closely together in a regular pattern and only vibrate in place.

blocks.text: In which state of matter are the particles furthest apart?

options.text: They are the same in all three

blocks.sentence: Ice ___ when it is heated and steam ___ when it is cooled.

blocks.text: A sealed balloon is left in a warm room. Use the particle model to predict what happens to it and explain why.
blocks.answer: It expands: the gas particles gain energy, move faster and push harder on the balloon, so it takes up more room.
